definitions.explanation: Money paid in excess of what was actually owed. Most often refers to interest overpaid on consumer loans that the borrower can legally reclaim.

examples.japanese: {過払|かはら}い{金|きん}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す。
{過払|かはら}い{金|きん}の{返還|へんかん}を{請求|せいきゅう}した。
examples.english: I filed a claim for a refund of the overpayment.

examples.japanese: {弁護士|べんごし}に{過払|かはら}い{金|きん}について{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I consulted a lawyer about overpaid interest.

notes:
A legal and financial term. In Japan it became widely known through claims to recover interest charged above the legal cap by consumer-finance lenders.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過払|かはら}い{金|きん}{請求|せいきゅう}: a claim for overpaid money
- {過払|かはら}い{金|きん}を{返還|へんかん}する: to refund an overpayment
- {過払|かはら}い{金|きん}が{発生|はっせい}する: an overpayment arises
